"It wasn't the ending we desired but we have moved forward," Versyp said Monday evening.
With four games left in the season, the Boilermakers won their initial four Big Ten games, providing them with an opportunity to reach the NCAA Tournament for the first time since 2015.
"This year was a process. Unfortunately, it's not an easy business," Versyp told PJT according to the press release. "But I'm proud of how our seniors stepped up and led. These ladies had a lot of character."
The senior class at Purdue consists of Teniya Page, Dominique Oden, Ae'Rianna Harris, and Carsen Edwards.
